HARBORVIEW REWARDS PROGRAM TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Effective April 14, 2026. Operated by Harborview Retail Group, Inc., 2400 Broadway, Suite 500, Oakland, California 94612.

1. ENROLLMENT. Membership is free and open to individuals 16 years of age or older who reside in the United States. You enroll by creating an account and agreeing to these Terms. One membership per person. A membership is personal to you, is not transferable, and has no cash value.

2. EARNING POINTS. You earn 1 point per $1 spent on qualifying purchases, before tax, shipping, and any discount applied. Gift cards, taxes, shipping, and third-party marketplace purchases do not earn points. Points post to your account within 7 days after the order ships.

3. REDEEMING POINTS. 100 points redeem for $5 off a purchase. Points may be redeemed only in increments of 100 and only at checkout. Points have no cash value, are not property, and may not be sold, transferred, bartered, or combined with another member's points except as Section 8 provides.

4. FINANCIAL INCENTIVE NOTICE (California). This program is a financial incentive program under the California Consumer Privacy Act, Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.125(b). By joining, you allow us to collect and use your name, email address, phone number, and purchase history in connection with the program. The material terms are stated above: you earn 1 point per dollar and redeem 100 points for $5. We estimate the value of your personal information to be approximately equal to the value of the incentive we offer, which averaged $0.47 per member per month over the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, calculated as the total value of rewards redeemed divided by the number of active members. You may withdraw from the program at any time by contacting us at rewards@harborview.example or 1-800-555-0143, and withdrawing forfeits any unredeemed points.

5. EXPIRATION. Points expire 24 months after they are earned if your account has no qualifying purchase in that period. We will email you at least 30 days before points expire. Points earned by a California member do not expire while your account is active, as Cal. Civ. Code § 1749.5 requires for the cash-value portion of any award.

6. PROGRAM CHANGES. We may change these Terms, the earning rate, the redemption rate, or the benefits of the program. We will give at least 30 days' notice by email and on our website before any change that reduces the value of points you have already earned, and you may redeem your points during that period at the prior rate.

7. TERMINATION OF THE PROGRAM. We may end the program on 90 days' notice. You may redeem your points during that period. Unredeemed points are forfeited when the program ends.

8. TERMINATION OF YOUR MEMBERSHIP. You may close your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account for fraud, abuse, a violation of these Terms, or a chargeback, and forfeit its points, after giving you notice and a reasonable opportunity to respond, except where immediate action is needed to prevent ongoing fraud.

9. TAXES. You are responsible for any tax on rewards you receive.

10. PRIVACY. Our Privacy Policy at harborview.example/privacy describes what we collect and how we use it, including your rights to know, delete, correct, and opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information.

11. DISPUTES. These Terms are governed by California law. Any dispute will be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Alameda County, California, and each of us consents to that venue. Nothing in these Terms limits your right to bring a claim in small-claims court or to file a complaint with a government agency.

12. CONTACT. Harborview Retail Group, Inc., Attn: Rewards, 2400 Broadway, Suite 500, Oakland, California 94612, rewards@harborview.example, 1-800-555-0143.
